name: a11y-keyboard-operability-pass
description: Walks every inventory page and every interactive component with the keyboard only, checking each control against its WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices key map, and records failures of SC 2.1.1 Keyboard, 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap, 2.1.4 Character Key Shortcuts, 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks, 3.2.1 On Focus and 3.2.2 On Input.
